name: google/gemini-4-hydrogen
description: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is the high-efficiency model of Google's Gemini 4 family, released on November 12, 2026. Google built it for high-throughput agentic workflows, coding and multi-model routing at lower cost and latency than the larger Gemini 4 models. It accepts text, image, video, audio and PDF input with a 1M-token context window, supports adjustable reasoning effort, and supports function calling and structured output.
